findings.finding: A bus hand-off would fire on listeners that do not own a live session and once per listener.
findings.answer: Plan 2.2: hand off only when the global session registry (envoy_sessions) has no entry, and publish with a JetStream message id from the envelope's dedupe_key so copies collapse; task 6 tests two machines.

findings.finding: A 202 hand-off body breaks every send/publish client.
findings.answer: Plan 2.2: answer 200 with the same envelope body as a delivered message and recipient set to the target; no client changes.

findings.finding: A generic gh on the daemon host lets the model run code with the daemon's secrets.
findings.answer: Plan 2.7: allow list of gh first words, everything else refused before it runs; scrubbed environment with empty HOME/XDG; recorded on the PR as a security decision; task 8 tests refused forms never run.

findings.finding: answerGate as written deadlocks against the machine lock.
findings.answer: Plan 2.8: gate state is its own (appending, started); the loop reads only Machine.View() and the gate, never Claim(); start waits at most 10 s; race test.

findings.finding: #2163 reads the loop's answer as a hand-back, and its relay can wake a parked tree in A1.
findings.answer: Plan 2.8: dispatchAskReply skips comments carrying the legion-answer marker, tested on an admitted root; A1's rig uses a person's park (backlog); task 11's controller skill treats a parked decision whose thread holds the loop's answer to a question as no reason to re-admit.

findings.finding: Controller notices are live-only, so passed questions can be lost.
findings.answer: Plan 2.8: legion state lists questionsForController (last 7 days), read by the controller at start; API version bump and contracts; A4/A5 rig check with the controller stopped.

findings.finding: The new KV bucket needs grants and a release order.
findings.answer: The bucket and its grant are INFRA-448's (architect's decision); the hand-off publish grant is task 6 with its test; plan task 13 fixes the order (grants, listener and Dispatch, legion release, deployment config); the daemon tolerates an older listener's 404.
Plan 2.8: identity is dispatch:<message id>/<comment id> for Dispatch origins and the envelope dedupe_key for Envoy origins; a later attempt of the same message is the same question; tested.

findings.finding: A stale or overwritten registry swallows messages for good.
findings.answer:
Plan 2.1: hand-off only while project.

heartbeat is fresher than 3 minutes; one key per session (INFRA-448's layout); the daemon answers only sessions its own history holds.

findings.finding: Title backfill misses imported sessions, accepts forged titles and matches the controller.
findings.answer: Plan 2.4: read titles from the header lines when the column is NULL; exclude the controller and subagents; require the conversation's own envoy-role-claim or legion-managed-session entry to name the token; scanned never outranks registered; newest by header timestamp.

findings.finding: Appending after a torn last line corrupts the conversation.
findings.answer: Plan 2.5: the reader skips a malformed record as OMP's lenient parser does (session-loader.ts:161-177); the appender starts with a newline when the tail lacks one; contract fixtures for both stores.

findings.finding: The footer filter misses many ways to post.
findings.answer: Plan 2.7: only footer-checkable forms may post (pr comment/review --body, api REST literal body); --body-file, -F body=@, --input, graphql mutations and issue comment are refused; each tested.

findings.finding: Task ordering and cross-issue dependencies were wrong.
findings.answer: Plan section 3 dependency line: 5 then 6 then 7, 6 waits for INFRA-448, 10 waits for #2131 then #2163; the registry route question was settled by the architect (INFRA-448 owns it).

findings.finding: The capability check refuses registry-resolved agents.
findings.answer: Plan 2.3: a registry-resolved target skips the capability check; task 7 tests it.

findings.finding: cloudsql-iam is in scope with no task.
findings.answer: Plan 2.10: implemented through sessionproxy.Start with the daemon's own identity and configured login; in-process test through the stand-in dialer; no live proof possible and said so.

findings.finding: Acceptance gaps: database-store preamble, captured requests, A9, A18 determinism, production rights.
findings.answer: D2 builds runtime.tmux.session_store so the real daemon runs both stores locally (departure 4 for the architect); the rig has a recording reverse proxy; A9 checks the resumed agent's first captured request; A18 made deterministic by the footer's answer key lookup; kubectl get/list pods verified allowed from this pod.

findings.finding: The local rig lacks App keys and a second owner.
findings.answer: D5: the implementer requests both keys first with a reason, names the stage 4a second-owner repository; without them A15, A17, A18, A19 cannot be shown locally, reported to the architect.

findings.finding: Spec ambiguities: followers on an ask, old session of a replaced role, faults the asker hears.
findings.answer: Plan 5: only the ask's author answers; an old session answers from its own conversation (the Dispatch reply guard needs that session); the daemon replies in the agent's name for every fault and passes the question on.

findings.finding: Undeclared departures: kind none, no price, appended not re-answered, Envoy Go bump.
findings.answer: Recorded as specDepartures 1-3; the Envoy Go files move only where a go.work build needs them, each named on the PR.

specDepartures.spec: The model replies in one of three kinds: answered, not answered, a request for work its tools cannot do; notifications are never answered.
specDepartures.plan: A fourth kind, none, for a decision message or an agent's Envoy message that asks nothing; nothing is posted. Edits, resolutions, receipts and notices still never reach the model.
specDepartures.evidence: Spec 'Decisions it passes on' requires answering any question a decision message also asks, and agent messages may be informational; only the model can tell.

specDepartures.spec: The operator names per-token prices; the loop spends at most a daily dollar limit.
specDepartures.plan: A model with no configured price is not answered; the daemon replies naming the missing price and passes the question to the controller.
specDepartures.evidence: An unpriced model's cost cannot be logged (A14) or counted against the daily limit.

specDepartures.spec: A question whose answer had not posted when the daemon stopped is answered again.
specDepartures.plan: A question whose answer was already appended to the conversation but not posted is posted from what was appended, not answered again; earlier states are answered again with the recorded gh calls.
specDepartures.evidence: Answering again would put a second Q/A in the conversation, against A9's 'each once', and post a different answer than the conversation holds.

specDepartures.spec: Acceptance is shown with the real daemon run locally under both a database conversation store and tmux's files; no supported local deployment puts the real daemon's agents on a database store.
specDepartures.plan: Adds runtime.tmux.session_store: postgres (pane OMP_SESSION_STORAGE=sql, boot probe, row-based resume check) as the proof surface; the alternative is an acceptance change the spec's approver must accept.
specDepartures.evidence: Session store is a Kubernetes-only setting (internal/config/kubernetes.go:69-74); this pod cannot create Sandboxes and stage 4 scripts are devbox-only.

outcome.scope: One new tmux runtime setting, runtime.tmux.session_store, not named by the spec.
